# Anontalk

> An online place to discuss everyday worries under a nickname, share message-in-a-bottle stories, explore dilemmas and read practical articles.

## Public content
- [Home and frequently asked questions](https://anontalk.online/)
- [Blog and individual articles](https://anontalk.online/blog)
- [Public dilemmas and archive](https://anontalk.online/dilemma)
- [Message in a Bottle](https://anontalk.online/bottles)
- [Wellness activities](https://anontalk.online/wellness)
- [Sitemap](https://anontalk.online/sitemap.xml)

## Account and privacy boundaries
Public blog articles and dilemma prompts can be read without an account. Chatting, voting, comments and bottles require a verified account. Customer registration uses a nickname, email and a password of at least eight characters. A nickname is not a guarantee of absolute technical anonymity: account data and messages are processed to provide the service. Do not share personal contact details.

## Credits
A new account receives five free sent chat messages. Each customer message costs one credit; chat partner replies are free. Additional credits are sold in bundles through Stripe. No subscription is required.

## Scope
Anontalk offers everyday conversation and peer perspective, not professional advice. Private chat transcripts, account records, votes and team screens are not public search content.
